submission.justification: D3 gives the highest light yield (52.8 PE/MeV at 30%), but 30% of its modules failed thermal cycling. That is far above the 5% limit, so D3 is ineligible. The modules cannot be accessed once the cryostat is filled. Of the two designs that pass, D1 yields more than D2 at every coverage level. D1's failure rate is 2%, against 0.5% for D2. Yield rises monotonically with coverage, so the maximum allowed coverage of 30% is best. At 30%, D1 gives about 37.9 PE/MeV against 26.9 for D2. The cost of requiring robustness is about 14.9 PE/MeV compared with D3. D1 reaches 71.8% of D3's yield.

requirements.evidence: D1 at 30% gives 37.893 PE/MeV, the highest among the eligible designs. D3 would give 52.8 but is ineligible.

requirements.requirement: Module must be one of three designs in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: D1 is one of the listed designs.
D1 failure rate is 2%, below the 5% limit. It passed over 20 thermal cycles on a batch of 40. D3 failed at 30%.
The recommended coverage is 30%. Feedthrough maximum is also 30%.
